name: archdiag
description: Architecture diagrams from YAML: clean, hand-placed-looking SVG/PNG and Slack/terminal text
author: David Bernal

scripts.examples: node src/cli.js examples/checkout.yaml examples/output/checkout-doc --fit doc --type 1.3 --png --png-scale 1 && node src/cli.js examples/checkout.yaml examples/output/checkout-slide --fit slide --type 1.6 --png --png-scale 1 && node src/cli.js examples/checkout.yaml examples/output/checkout-text --ascii unicode --cols 100 && node src/cli.js examples/checkout.yaml examples/output/checkout-ascii --ascii ascii --cols 100 && node src/cli.js examples/fulfilment-streams.yaml examples/output/fulfilment-streams-doc --fit doc --type 1.3 --png --png-scale 1 && node src/cli.js examples/fulfilment-streams.yaml examples/output/fulfilment-streams-slide --fit slide --type 1.6 --png --png-scale 1 && rm -f examples/output/*.layout.json
scripts.check: node src/cli.js examples/checkout.yaml /tmp/archdiag-check --fit doc --check && node src/cli.js examples/fulfilment-streams.yaml /tmp/archdiag-check --fit doc --check && node src/cli.js test/fixtures/fulfilment-streams-flat.yaml /tmp/archdiag-check --fit doc --check && node src/cli.js test/fixtures/attachment-order.yaml /tmp/archdiag-check --fit doc --check
